key_idea: Compare the two lines: the second line has just one more mug of cocoa.
steps: Line 1: one banana and one mug cost 15 dollars.
Line 2 has the same banana and one extra mug, and costs 18 dollars.
So the extra mug costs 18 - 15 = 3 dollars.

choice_feedback.A: 3 dollars is the price of one mug. The question asks for two.
choice_feedback.C: Two mugs cost 3 + 3, which is not 9.
choice_feedback.D: 12 is the price of the banana, not two mugs.
choice_feedback.E: 15 is the price of one banana and one mug together.
